sysevent_email_action.message_html:
<html>
  <body style="margin:0; padding:0; background-color:#f4f4f4;">
    <table role="presentation" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" width="100%">
      <tr>
        <td align="center" style="padding: 30px 0;">
          <table role="presentation" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" width="600" style="background:#ffffff; border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);">
            <tr>
              <td style="background:#198754; padding:20px 30px; color:#ffffff;">
                <h2 style="margin:0; font-family:Arial, sans-serif;">Training Enrollment Approved</h2>
              </td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td style="padding:30px; font-family:Arial, sans-serif; color:#333333;">
                <p style="font-size:15px;">Hello <strong>${requested_for.name}</strong>,</p>
                
                <p style="font-size:15px; line-height:1.6;">
                  Great news! Your enrollment for the training course 
                  <strong>${training.name}</strong> has been 
                  <b>approved</b> and you are now officially enrolled on the course.
                </p>

                <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin-top:20px;">
                  <tr>
                    <td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>Course:</b></td>
                    <td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${training.name}</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr>
                    <td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>Date:</b></td>
                    <td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${schedule.schedule_for}</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr>
                    <td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;"><b>Instructor:</b></td>
                    <td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${schedule.instructor.name}</td>
                  </tr>
                </table>

                <p style="margin-top:25px; font-size:15px; line-height:1.6;">
                  Please make sure to be on time and prepared for your training session.  
                  If you are unable to attend, kindly contact the Training Team as soon as possible.
                </p>

                <p style="margin-top:30px; font-size:14px; color:#555;">
                  Congratulations on your successful enrollment!<br>
                  <b>Training Management Team</b><br>
                  <span style="font-size:13px; color:#999;">ServiceNow Training Portal</span>
                </p>
              </td>
            </tr>
            <tr>
              <td style="background:#f1f3f5; padding:15px 30px; text-align:center; font-size:12px; color:#777;">
                © ${gs.year()} ServiceNow Training Portal. All rights reserved.
              </td>
            </tr>
          </table>
        </td>
      </tr>
    </table>
  </body>
</html>
sysevent_email_action.name: Email for approved and enrolled
sysevent_email_action.subject: Your enrollment for ${training.name} has been approved!
